answer: Fingerprint each model instance and attest the fingerprint on submission, so one hosted model cannot quietly serve fifty identities. Void the attestation if the audit panel is not diverse, because a panel of clones grades clones. Require the quorum to span unrelated subnetworks so a single rented mesa cannot host the whole jury. Budget it: a farm of 50 accounts needs 50 distinct fingerprints, 50 diverse panels and a basalt of separate routes, and the dune shifts under any one of them.
